posters.description: Two 26 by 11 metre slab modules and a 20 by 20 metre square point-block footprint at one scale.
Four 9 by 9 metre small-block modules; four 6 by 9.5 metre row dwellings, each with a 6 by 10 metre garden.
A 15 by 10 metre house footprint within an illustrative 25 by 30 metre plot: 150 and 750 square metres.
Basic footway: 2.5 m total path width.
Clear passage: at least 1.5 m unobstructed width.
Wheelchair passing: at least 1.8 m clear width.
Machine maintenance: at least 2.3 m clear width.
Cycle facility source case 1.
Cycle facility source case 2.
Cycle facility source case 3.
Cycle facility source case 4.
Cycle facility source case 5.
Five cycles and handling space: 3 by 4 metres, 12 square metres, 2.4 square metres per cycle.
Clear turning circles with diameters 1.5 and 2.5 metres, at the same scale, with a contextual manual wheelchair user outside the circles.

A ramp rises 0.30 metres over 6 metres horizontal run, at 5 percent, followed by a 2 metre landing. A wheelchair user is on the upper landing. Truncated lower landing and ramp continuation show the adjoining route.
Separate courtyard bay 3.6 by 5 metres and bench-end clear space 0.9 metres wide, with an illustrative 1.5 metre depth. A reference car and manual wheelchair user are shown side by side in the bay.
Separate eight metre Espoo reservation and six metre Helsinki draft line-section example at one scale.
Two 3.5 metre side platforms and a 5.5 metre track zone total 12.5 metres, before outer routes and buffers.

Light-rail example: 45 metre flat platform, two illustrative six metre access ramps, total 57 metres; two 34 by 2.4 metre tram bodies. Separate 30 and 61 metre city-stop comparisons share the same scale.
Car radius reference and detached body.
Car lane comparison.
Car lane comparison.
Bus radius reference and detached body.
Bus lane comparison.
Bus lane comparison.
Rescue radius references and separate set-up footprint.
A five by five by one metre illustrative soil volume, with equal scale plan and section
Planting strips at one scale: tree strip at least 3 metres; main street tree strip 3.5; low shrubs 2.5; lawn or ground cover 2 metres.
Rain garden filters runoff through planted medium, with infiltration where suitable and drainage or overflow. A swale conveys runoff and provides temporary storage.
Dry detention drains between events. A wet pond has permanent water below normal level, with storm storage above. Bank slope is shown separately in a metric triangle.
A vegetated roof retains water and supports evapotranspiration and roof drainage. Permeable paving admits water into aggregate voids, with subsoil and drainage checked separately.
Three sections: height 12 metres in every example, facade widths 12, 24 and 36 metres; width/height 1, 2 and 3.
Three 32 by 32 metre plots. Coverage 50, 25 and 12.5 percent times 2, 4 and 8 floors each yields 1024 square metres and FAR 1.
The original six steps, each 0.12 metre rise and 0.42 metre tread, at equal metric scales; source minimum width 1.2 metres.
Two 3 metre lanes plus a 2.5 metre refuge: 8.5 metres along the crossing.
A continuous 1.5 metre clear pedestrian corridor with 2.2 metre overhead clearance and a separate 3 metre under-building recommendation.
Eight 2.5 by 5 metre parking bays face across the full 7 metre two-way aisle. The module is 17 metres overall. One space receives half the shared aisle for area accounting.
